images.title: Read from both ends
images.purpose: Show that a palindrome reads the same from both ends, with the first and last digits matching, and list four palindromes.
images.composition: The digits of 2,442 with two mirror arcs, and the palindromes 303, 313, 323 and 333.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A number read from both ends, and four palindromes. The label 2,442 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (72 px) is centred at x 728, y 70. FOUR DIGIT BOXES in a row, each a rounded rectangle 130 by 150 px, y 250 to 400, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px, filled teal #0072B2, at x 400 to 530, 560 to 690, 720 to 850 and 880 to 1010, holding in white bold sans-serif (80 px) the digits 2, 4, 4 and 2. OUTER ARC: a curved arrow in reddish purple #CC79A7 (5 px) above the boxes joining the top of the first box (x 465, y 250) and the top of the fourth box (x 945, y 250), peaking at y 150, with the word same in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px) centred at x 705, y 130. INNER ARC: a curved arrow in reddish purple (5 px) below the boxes joining the bottom of the second box (x 625, y 400) and the bottom of the third box (x 785, y 400), dipping to y 470, with the word same in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px) centred at x 705, y 510. At the bottom, a row of four rounded rectangles 200 by 100 px, y 610 to 710, outlined green #009E73 (4 px), at x 280 to 480, 520 to 720, 760 to 960 and 1000 to 1200, holding in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (64 px) the numbers 303, 313, 323 and 333, and above them, centred at x 740, y 575, the caption Palindromes from 300 to 340 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (40 px). No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than two arcs
palindromes other than 303, 313, 323 and 333 in the bottom row
images.takeaway: A palindrome reads the same both ways: match the first and last digits, then the next pair in.
images.description: The number 2,442 as four digit boxes with two mirror arcs marked same, and the numbers 303, 313, 323 and 333.
images.context: Concept image for Palindrome Numbers, using the example's own numbers (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Read 2,442 aloud from the left and then from the right. The slip to watch: thinking all the digits must be the same.

image_decisions.why: The mirror arcs show what a palindrome is.
